article.story: MACOMB, Ill. -- — Travis Harper II had 23 points in Tennessee State's 90-68 victory over Western Illinois on Thursday. Harper shot 7 of 10 from the field, including 3 for 6 from 3-point range, and went 6 for 6 from the line for the Tigers (10-5, 4-1 Ohio Valley Conference). Khalil London scored 15 points off the bench, shooting 6 for 8, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc. Antoine Lorick III finished with 13 points. Isaiah Griffin led the Leathernecks (4-12, 0-5) in scoring, finishing with 14 points and seven rebounds. Antwaun Massey added 12 points for Western Illinois. Lucas Lorenzen also recorded 11 points and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
